SR-5
STEERING - POWER STEERING FLUID
INSPECTION
1. CHECK FLUID LEVEL
(a) Keep the vehicle level.
COLD (b) With the engine stopped, check the fluid level in the oil
reservoir.
If necessary, add fluid,
Fluid: ATF DEXRON® II or Ill
HINT:
Check that the fluid level is within the HOT LEVEL range on the
reservoir, If the fluid is cold, check that it is within the COLO
LEVEL range.
(c) Start the engine and run it at idle.
(d) Turn the steering wheel from lock to lock several times to
boost fluid temperature.
Flu id temperature: 80 • C {176 • F)
(e) Check for foaming or emulsification.
Normal Abnormal lf there is foaming or emulsification, bleed power steering sys•
tern (See page SR-4).
(f) With the engine idling, measure the fluid level in the all
reservoir,
(g) Stop the engine.
(h) Wait a few minutes and remeasure the fluid level in the oil
reservoir.
Maximum fluid level rise: 5 mm (0.20 in.)
If a problem is found, bleed power steering system (See page
SR-4).
